text:
maria: Quick proposal - add an `effective_identity` enum to request telemetry (org-key | project-key | sa-exchange). For observability only initially.
devon: Yep, `request.origin` is ambiguous for exchanges.
kevin: Important: do not use raw IDs. Enum + optional hashed correlation only.
jess: Implementation idea: proxy emits enum sync, then async `identity_resolved` event with more context.
sam: Privacy check - we should show it to org admins only and include docs blurb.
kevin: Also emit metric `identity.routing.delta` tag:identity,route to measure mismatches.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry-annotator canary started (5%)
maria: Rollout plan: proxy annotator -> backfill 7 days -> Console FF to surface column -> 10d telemetry -> decide routing experiments.
jess: Will open PR for annotator + schema. Kevin, can you stub the dashboard?
kevin: On it. I'll add `identity.enrich.latency` & `identity.resolution.failures`.
devon: Note: if routing later uses this, billing/quota must stay tied to original billing project.
maria: Agreed. Tasks assigned. Landing telemetry PR by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
